name: response value
source:
import { defineApplicationRoutes } from "./proposal";
export const routes = defineApplicationRoutes()({"/health":new Response("ok")});

name: native literal parameter and server inference
source:
import { defineApplicationRoutes } from "./proposal";
export const routes = defineApplicationRoutes()({"/items/:id":(request,server)=>{const id:string=request.params.id; const ip=server.requestIP(request); return Response.json({id,ip});}});

name: native method callback inference
source:
import { defineApplicationRoutes } from "./proposal";
export const routes = defineApplicationRoutes()({"/items/:id":{GET:request=>Response.json({id:request.params.id}),POST:async(request,server)=>Response.json({id:request.params.id,port:server.port})}});

name: API cache and explicit MFA document narrowing
source:
import type { ApiRouteContext } from "./proposal";
export function route(context:ApiRouteContext,request:Request){if(context.documents)return context.documents.render("auth/mfa-challenge",{}, {request}); return context.cachedJson("key",async()=>({ok:true}),[],request);}

source:
import type { ApiRouteContext,WebRouteContext } from "./proposal";

source:
import type {DocumentRenderer} from "./proposal";
